title: How long is GTA 6 compared to GTA 5
yt_title: Is GTA 6 TWICE as long as GTA 5? ⏱️
description: How long is GTA 6? Reviewers clock the main story at about 45 to 80 hours depending on the outlet (Kotaku, VGC, GameSpot, GamesRadar), versus about 31.5 hours for GTA 5 (HowLongToBeat average). Rockstar North's Rob Nelson says his own playthrough took about 80 hours. The story has 90+ missions across five chapters (PC Gamer, GamesRadar), and 100+ hours with side content. No spoilers. Will you finish it in under 80 hours?
